payload.reason: The evidence indicates that RR-based fingerprint construction is crucial for enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in detecting forced climate responses. Without it, the ability to distinguish forced changes from internal variability would be compromised, leading to lower SNR and potentially less reliable detection outcomes.

claims.text: RR-based fingerprint construction significantly improves the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in detecting forced climate responses.
Without RR-based fingerprint construction, the detection of forced changes would be less reliable due to increased internal variability.
